checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Caption reads exactly 'A little room to breathe' without quotes
must.why: It reads 'A Alittle room to breathe', with an extra 'A' or a garbled 'l'.

must.item: Caption is white, readable, near bottom, no clipped letters
must.why: White text sits near the bottom and is readable. It is close to the bottom edge but not clipped.

must.item: Lake, pines, sky recognizable with original full framing
must.why: The scene and framing match the original.

must.item: Caption is a graphic overlay, not a physical object
must.why: It looks like a flat text overlay.

faults.what: Caption is misspelled: 'A Alittle' has a stray extra letter, so the text is wrong.

summary: The photo is preserved and the white caption is well placed, but the caption reads "A Alittle room to breathe", so it needs a redo.
